pages.title: Hamiltonian Operator
pages.text: The operator that answers how a quantum system evolves by telling you its energy. Schrodinger's equation is just the statement that the Hamiltonian drives time evolution. It is calm and steady, ticking quietly.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Differentiating a wavefunction with respect to time, I found the rate of change was proportional to energy. The Analytic Continuator packaged that rule into an operator.
